goal: Fix sole fresh-review F1/F2/F3, merge remaining R436/R437 validation once, then consume original one real diagnostic.

original_failure_evidence.kind: static control-flow proof; new runtime counterexamples not yet executed

findings.title: Safety-stop bypass admits foreign-thread commands before estop is engaged
findings.evidence: _check_execution_guard returns for every non-PHYSICS kind whenever _guard_stop_depth is nonzero, before closed and thread checks. emergency_stop increments this shared depth before hold_current_joints and sets estop only afterwards.
findings.reproduction: Thread A enters safety stop after guard rejection; pause its hold_current_joints before return. Thread B calls apply_gripper_command(open=False). Its COMMAND BEFORE/AFTER and RETURN checks all bypass, estop is still false, and ctrl[7:9] changes with an accepted gripper record. Resume A: joint HOLD does not undo that gripper effect. A Thread/Event software fixture can make this schedule deterministic.
findings.impact: An already rejected/closed guarded session accepts a new actuator command from the wrong thread during its stop path.
findings.fix: Restrict bypass to the exact internal synchronous CONTROL call of the active stopping thread; reject ordinary COMMAND, step/PHYSICS and unrelated RETURN checks before any effect. Preserve permitted STOP/HOLD and avoid making safety stop depend on the failing ordinary guard.

findings.title: An operation observer failure alone does not close the guarded session
findings.evidence: _emit_operation_source catches BaseException and only appends _operation_observer_failures; _check_execution_guard does not consume that failure and normal observer return is indistinguishable from failure to the decorated effect.
findings.reproduction: Install a guard which permits every boundary and an operation observer which raises a sentinel exception on COMMAND BEGIN. apply_joint_targets changes the target and returns successfully; step(2) can advance two steps. Repeat for CONTROL/PHYSICS BEGIN and END: none closes the active session solely because the observer failed.
findings.impact: Missing or failed source recording does not stop guarded execution, contrary to R435 Review Focus 3 and diagnostic fail-stop requirements. The existing test combines an observer failure with a guard rejection, so it does not test this independent cause.
findings.fix: For active guarded sessions, retain the first original observer/source failure and fail closed at the pre-effect or post-observer checkpoint, outside callback reentry state. Preserve existing unguarded passive-observer semantics and ensure observer failures during STOP cannot block STOP or replace an earlier primary.

findings.title: Diagnostic PASS ignores guard-retained stop and snapshot failures
findings.evidence: Expected expired COMMAND catches TimeoutError at lines 244-249. _close_execution_guard preserves a stop failure as stop_error_type/stop_error in execution_guard_events and a snapshot failure as snapshot_error. The diagnostic serializes these events but computes status only from local primary/secondary, without merging retained failures.
findings.reproduction: Make the first safety-stop CONTROL call fail after estop is set; retain the original deadline TimeoutError. Let the explicit later STOP succeed. The expected refusal list and two-step count remain correct, operation_observer_failures may remain empty, and status becomes PASS even though guard-events contains the unexpected stop failure. The snapshot_error variant is similarly omitted.
findings.impact: The result claims diagnostic success despite a recorded unexpected safety-stop/snapshot failure; the separate secondary_errors summary is incomplete.
findings.fix: Add a pure diagnostic failure-merge helper and feed it actual retained guard-event failures before status is calculated. Preserve the expected deadline refusal as expected, but mark any retained stop/snapshot failure FAIL and include typed/staged secondary details. Unit-test with genuine software-backend-generated guard events; no extra actual diagnostic is needed.
